title: SG-2.1 Typed manifest interfaces and zod validators
summary: Add typed asset manifest interfaces and runtime zod validators under game/src/assets/manifest
description: Context: game/ has a yaml-only runtime (game/package.json) with src/content, engine, state and systems, but no src/assets folder. Desired behavior: a typed asset manifest module with zod runtime validators covering asset id, path, type, dimensions, spritesheet frames, animations, origin/anchor and interaction bounds. Expected result: later cycles can validate manifest JSON without touching the engine. Why: AI-friendly, validated content architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Given game/package.json, when read, then zod is declared as a dependency
Given a valid manifest object, when validated, then typed data is returned
Given an invalid manifest object, when validated, then a failure naming the bad field path is returned
Given the module, when imported, then TypeScript interfaces exist for id, path, type, dimensions, frames, animations, origin and interaction bounds

preserve: Existing game/src/content, engine, state and systems behavior

definition_of_done: All three requirements delivered and verified by unit tests
